Unit 5 Study Guide: Evolution

Review everything on the Unit 5 test: natural selection and fitness, the three types of selection, the bird beak and peppered moth labs, species and speciation (geographic, behavioral, and temporal isolation), genetic drift and gene flow, and the evidence of evolution.
